description: Find English synonyms, antonyms, broader categories, or narrower kinds of a word. Broader returns direct hypernyms and narrower returns direct hyponyms. Preserve Datamuse ranking; frequency metadata does not determine ordering. Empty results succeed; best-effort offsets re-run the query under a whole-row byte budget.

include_definitions.description: Include upstream definitions; senses may make the response substantially larger.

include_ipa.description: Request IPA tags and imply pronunciation; raw ARPAbet and IPA tags may both be returned.

include_pronunciation.description: Request raw pronunciation tags; ARPAbet stress digits are 0 unstressed, 1 primary, 2 secondary. May be guessed or omitted.

limit.description: Positive safe-integer row limit, default 20; values above 1000 are clamped and disclosed. Whole rows may be cut by the response byte budget.

offset.description: Best-effort row offset, 0–999; re-runs the query, so rankings may change. No snapshot or total count.

relation.description: Lexical relation; broader returns hypernyms and narrower returns hyponyms.

word.description: Nonblank target word or phrase, at most 200 characters; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

name: datamuse_find_synonyms

effectiveQuery.description: Normalized search inputs, relations, defaults, and metadata flags.

include_pronunciation.description: Whether pronunciation was requested, including when implied by IPA.

ipa.description: Resolved upstream IPA selector when enabled.

requestedLimit.description: Original positive safe-integer limit when clamped above 1000.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_rejected`: HTTP 400. `upstream_validation`: HTTP 422. `upstream_unauthorized`: HTTP 401. `upstream_forbidden`: HTTP 403. `upstream_not_found`: HTTP 404 on the fixed endpoint. `upstream_conflict`: HTTP 409. `upstream_rate_limited`: HTTP 429. `pacer_shed`: Shared queue full or wait budget exhausted. `invalid_upstream_response`: Invalid JSON or malformed response shape. `upstream_unexpected_status`: Unexpected redirect or other non-success status. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitReached.description: Whether the returned count equals the requested cap; more matches may exist.

nextOffset.description: Best-effort next row index within the API ceiling, when a byte cut or reached fetch cap permits navigation; not a stable cursor.

returnedCount.description: Number of returned words, not a total-match estimate.

truncated.description: Whether complete rows were omitted locally by the byte budget; not upstream exhaustion.

words.description: Matching upstream rows in original order; empty is a successful result.

defHeadword.description: Optional upstream headword associated with definitions.

defs.description: Optional raw definitions; tabs and whitespace are preserved.

numSyllables.description: Optional upstream syllable count, which may be guessed.

score.description: Optional upstream ranking score; not confidence or frequency.

tags.description: Optional raw metadata tags, including unknown tags.

word.description: Upstream word or phrase, preserved exactly.

title: Datamuse Find Synonyms
